But my father still behaves like that. Now my mother asks me and my younger brother to hold our fathers neck and ask him to stop his misdeeds. On the other hand my father always abuses my mother everyday. I know both are at fault but most of the time its my father who has not control on his anger and make a bigg issue out of nothing an starts abusing my mother. answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 7853 Country: India Title: Respected Mufti Saheb! As Salaam vaalekum I often see that some people use jai bheem or jai maaya instead of as salaam vaalekum or wising to each other by meeting to one another. Is using of Jai bheem/jai maaya instead of as salaam vaalekum in any discussion or wishing to each other is justifiable according to our Islam darm ? I am very much confused on this matter pls do reply and if this is going wrong pls help me to remedy this situation and issue the Fatwa. Question: Respected Mufti Saheb! Answer ID: 7853 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1624/1542=D/1429) Muslims must adopt their Islamic traditions. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
